text:
eli: Heads-up  we need a lean two-email welcome + launch drip for the benchmark webinar next week. Minimal images, clear CTAs.

maria: I can run. Primary cohorts: new-signups (14d) and trial-engaged (recent API usage). We'll add a one-off retarget for opened-but-not-registered.

josh: Suggest cadence: Day 0 invite, Day 3 reminder. For trial-engaged replace Day 3 with a technical brief emphasizing latency/cost numbers and a 2-CTA layout.

anya: I'll create the watchlist segment and exclusion rules (no send if already registered).

lia: I'll prepare compressed hero + mobile banner + plain-text fallback. GIF only for trial-engaged.

josh: Subject line ideas for new-signups:
1) "Live benchmark: 3x cost improvements on inference"
2) "See the data: inference latency & cost compared"
Preview text for both. UTM: `utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bench_3098`

maria: A/B test subject lines for new-signups, and test 1-CTA vs 2-CTA for trial-engaged. APAC window 09:00-11:00 local. Keep welcome email under 120 words.

campaign-bot: campaign-scheduler: created id=cmp_2026_3098; status=draft; owner=maria

samir: KPIs: open rate, CTR->register, register->attend, demo request rate. Also CPL by cohort.

maria: Lia drop assets to #marketing-assets by EOD. Josh post copy variants by 3pm. QA tomorrow 11:30am.

eli: Thanks team.
